The '''''Constrainer''''' was an [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].<ref name="DFR1" />

==History==
The ''Constrainer'' played a major role in the [[Thrawn campaign]], being used in Thrawn's unsuccessful attempt to capture [[Talon Karrde]] at [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]].<ref name="DFR1" /> [[Pit Lieutenant]] [[Dezon]] served abourd the ship.<ref name="Bridge Pit" /> The vessel later fought at the [[Battle of Bilbringi (9 ABY)|Battle of Bilbringi]].<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>
